references.text: The preceding verse describes the sixty cities in the region of Og that were conquered, and verse 5 gives details about their fortifications.
The spies reported on fortified cities with high walls in the land of Canaan, a similar description of strong cities.
Jericho was a fortified city with gates and bars, the same type of fortifications described in Deuteronomy 3:5.
It mentions fortified cities with gates and bars, using the same terminology for city fortifications.
Esther describes Susa as a city with gates, using the same type of fortification terminology.
The Israelites were afraid of the great and fortified cities with walls reaching to heaven, a parallel description.
It describes Solomon's dominion over the region of Bashan with fortified cities, the same geographical area.
